item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02680","case1_error":"Subtracts car expenses from the console price instead of subtracting remaining savings; the shortfall is $320, requiring 16 hours.","case2_error":"Counts five family members instead of four, dividing 672 by the wrong number of people.","reason":"The first misrepresents how expenses affect available savings; the second miscounts the recipients of an equal division.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02681","case1_error":"Assumes selling price equals construction cost, then subtracts the extra $100,000 twice when determining additional profit.","case2_error":"Treats monthly material costs as per-vehicle costs, multiplying each total cost by production quantity.","reason":"The first conflates sale price with cost and double-counts incremental spending; the second confuses aggregate costs with unit costs.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02682","case1_error":"Applies the 20% car-payment proportion to gross income instead of after-tax income, yielding $2,000 instead of $3,000.","case2_error":"Reports $300 after explicitly defining the answer as net earnings; its correct unevaluated formulas yield $270.","reason":"The first writes an incorrect percentage relation. The second supplies an unsupported final number inconsistent with its correct net-income formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02683","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width from its width equation, treating the target width as the required increase.","case2_error":"Returns the total travel time, 168 minutes, instead of the requested average, 56 minutes.","reason":"The first uses an erroneous relation missing an initial value; the second correctly computes and reports the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02684","case1_error":"Divides retained water rather than allowable water loss by loss per jump, then unjustifiably subtracts the resulting count from itself.","case2_error":"Subtracts one bun per excluded guest instead of three, producing 28 required buns rather than 24.","reason":"The first confuses retained volume with lost volume and adds an invalid subtraction; the second fails to scale excluded guests by buns per guest.","judgment":"different"}]}
